<section class="cs-hero">
  <div style="max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>Population and Access</h1>
    <p>How many people live within walking or driving distance of an accredited outlet &mdash; and where the equity gaps sit.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="cs-wrap">
  <span class="cs-badge">Coming soon</span>
  <h2>What this layer will show</h2>
  <p>Facility counts alone do not tell us whether a rural mother can actually reach medicines when her child spikes a fever. This layer overlays outlet locations on population surfaces and road-network isochrones to expose the real reachability picture.</p>

  <ul class="cs-list">
    <li>ADDOs per 10,000 population, by region and district.</li>
    <li>Walking-time and drive-time isochrones (15/30/60 min) around every geocoded outlet.</li>
    <li>Population-weighted coverage: percentage of population within X minutes of the nearest accredited outlet.</li>
    <li>Equity gaps: wards where population is high but accredited-outlet coverage is low.</li>
  </ul>

  <div class="cs-cta">
    While this layer is being built, the <a href="registry.html">CPP Registry</a> already lets you filter by region and district and inspect the raw geographic distribution.
  </div>
